<thought>Since the previous searches returned no templates, I will broaden the criteria further: only require breaking a ketone and forming an aliphatic hydroxyl (the key changes of the carbonyl‑ene reaction). This should retrieve any template that can perform the intramolecular carbonyl‑ene transformation on the target molecule.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "[CH2:1]=[C:2]([c:3]1[cH:4][cH:5][cH:6][cH:7][cH:8]1)[C@@H:9]1[CH2:10][CH2:11][CH2:12][C@@:13]1([OH:14])[C:15]([F:16])([F:17])[F:18]",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["ketones"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["aliphatic hydroxyls"],
    "limit": 10
}
</action_input>
